answers.observation: The ball visibly rolls, collides, rebounds and continues to settle under solver-owned inertia.
All three bottles respond continuously at first contact with no visible gap, deep penetration or pose jump.
Two bottles stay horizontal and one returns upright; differing masses and micro-variation produce an uncomposed result.
The ball reads at regulation scale with dark seams, rounded silhouette and stable fine surface breakup.
Smooth translucent shells, lips, shoulders, caps, labels, base rings and three distinct internal fill levels remain legible without transmission noise.
Boards, seams, painted line, baseboards, two enclosing walls and bench establish a bounded human-scale court.
The cause shot clearly establishes ball trajectory and target spacing without fitting the full floor.
The exact first-contact still and fixed-camera 48-frame clip preserve collision direction and native physical motion blur.
The effect view is the derived end of the ten-frame settle window and shows all three supported final contacts without posing.
The result is materially and spatially more believable than RC3 H1 while preserving at least equal physics clarity.

claimCeiling: One procedurally art-directed, solver-owned basketball and filled-bottle scene with stable Eevee film-glass. This does not prove optical refraction, liquid dynamics, deformation, breakage, sound, external assets, cross-platform behavior or photoreal arbitrary filmmaking.
